transport.binding: SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 request bytes; response digest/schema/evaluator must match; result instance IDs exactly preserve request order with no omissions, additions or duplicates
transport.evaluatorBinding: evaluatorVersion is immutable and binds engine jsxgraph@1.13.2, schemaVersion and this contractVersion; any normative change after release requires a new evaluatorVersion
transport.resultSemantics: valid=true requires zero diagnostics; valid=false requires 1..32 diagnostics; initial state only; no geometry coordinates or HTML in response
transport.deadlines: overall begins after authentication and includes body read, digest/schema validation, worker startup and computation; compute begins at worker ready handshake; abort/terminate outside evaluator thread; retain slot until termination completes

scalarSemantics.powOrder: negative: reciprocal first; multiply left-to-right abs(exponent) times starting at 1; zero base and nonpositive exponent undefined
scalarSemantics.nodeCounting: each scalar expression value counts once: numeric literal, parameter-reference object or operation object; args array containers, op-name strings and parameter-name strings do not count as additional AST nodes
scalarSemantics.depthCounting: scalar root depth is 1; entering each operand expression adds 1; args containers add no AST depth; full-envelope JSON depth and node counting are independent

valueEntry: safe JSON deep copy, visiting root depth 0: node count before depth before value validity; object fields in own-key order and array elements in index order
envelope record and exact fields; envelope version and kitVersion; kitId registration
spec record and exact fields; spec version; kit dimension; ariaLabel; units
parameters, objects, measurements, assertions array shape/count and entry-record checks in this order
parameters in array order: exact fields, claim global ID, finite initial, min/max/step/range
claim object IDs, then measurement IDs, then assertion IDs, each in array order
validate objects, then measurements, then assertions, each in array order: kind, dimension, exact fields, then field types/references/scalar AST in shared signature field order

object DAG depth-first validation starting with ASCII-sorted IDs, following shared signature reference-field order: cycle before cached depth; path depth limit after dependency traversal; parameters are independent inputs outside object DAG depth
presentation exact fields; objects, measurements, groups, rightAngles in array order; camera
interaction exact fields; parameter references; selectable references; visibleGroups references; reset; freedoms in array order
validationOrder.exactFields: unknown fields in input own-key order precede missing required fields in shared declaration order
validationOrder.scalar: root depth bound, then preorder expression traversal: node limit before depth limit; literal finite check or exact parameter reference; operation exact fields then known op then arity then literal integer power bound then operands left-to-right
validationOrder.freedom: claim global ID, reference target object, duplicate target, kind-specific exact fields/type, bindings/ranges and alias checks in declared coordinate order; translation checks direct-transform source closure before axes/ranges, binds in ranges array order, then checks edited-parameter source closure
validationOrder.failure: stop at first failure; matching TS/Java fixtures must return the same reason code; paths identify the actual first failure and are not inferred from subsequent invalid fields

spatial.semantics: finite nonzero view/up vectors with finite norms; normalized cross norm>1e-9; zoom 0.01..100

conventions.linearDomain: line, parallelLine, perpendicularLine, normalLine and intersectPlanes: all t; segment: 0<=t<=1; ray: t>=0; feet and pointLineDistance use supporting infinite line
conventions.intersectionBranch: lower/upper ordered affine line t; tangent coalesces; missing branch undefined; reappearance uses same order
conventions.planeFrame: e1=normalize(U-O); n=normalize(cross(U-O,V-O)); e2=cross(n,e1); O+u*e1+v*e2; parallelPlane inherits axes and replaces origin
conventions.linearParameterization: every linear object is O+t*d: line/segment/ray O=a,d=b-a; parallelLine O=point,d=source d preserving magnitude; perpendicularLine O=point,d=positive90(source d) preserving magnitude; normalLine O=point,d=ordered plane unit normal; intersectPlanes O=unique point on intersection closest to world origin,d=normalize(cross(n1,n2)) using ordered plane unit normals
conventions.planeIntersectionDirection: normalize(cross(first ordered unit normal,second ordered unit normal)); origin is unique closest point to world origin
conventions.perpendicularLine: 2D positive 90 degree counterclockwise rotation maps source direction (dx,dy) to (-dy,dx), preserving magnitude; origin is declared point
conventions.pointOnCircle: center+radius*[cos(angle),sin(angle)]; angle zero points along global +x; positive angles are counterclockwise; angle in radians
conventions.rotate: 2D counterclockwise about center; 3D right-hand rule about any referenced linear object's canonical O,d, using O as axis anchor and normalized d as direction; linear segment/ray domains do not restrict the rotation axis
conventions.mirror: reconstruct faces from transformed shared vertices; winding order retained; spatial orientation reverses
conventions.dihedralAngle: validate edge in both planes and qi in corresponding plane; normalize qi-O projected perpendicular to edge; atan2(cross norm,dot), no absolute dot
conventions.assertions: passive numerical residual checks; no solver; parallel/perpendicular accepts linear-linear, plane-plane or linear-plane; coplanar requires 4+ points with a noncollinear frame; onLine respects the referenced line/segment/ray domain with the fixed numerical tolerance, unlike supporting-line feet and pointLineDistance
conventions.range: finite min<max, min<=initial<=max, finite 0<step<=max-min; continuous values need not align to step
conventions.mobility: freePoint constants; pointOnLine t, pointOnCircle angle, pointOnPlane u/v or shared translate fields must be literal numbers or exact parameter references; aliases require identical ranges; composite AST remains derived
conventions.translation: freedom object is a segment whose two distinct transformPoint endpoints reference the same translate node; source-point dependency closures cannot contain this translation or reference its edited parameters; declared axes map directly to dx/dy/dz; unlisted axes remain fixed
conventions.pageBudgetPrecedence: validated kit and nonnegative integer byte metadata, aggregate bytes, marker count, individual bytes, heavy count
conventions.rightAngleMarkers: reference an angular measurement; render only while defined and within angleDegrees of 90, never treat as an assertion
conventions.jsonAccounting: root depth 0; every JSON value is one node (keys excluded); UTF-8 compact JSON bytes; AST owns its subtree, parent category owns field key and punctuation; remaining bytes/nodes belong to envelope; disjoint totals
